full_page.content:
Page 5 Nov.
Margaret Donnigan - 58 - obstruction of intestines cancer feared -
Fred Eastman - 44 - lame back .... strang case ... went to 6 different sunday. schools ... now atheist. His ideal would be to just go asleep and be no more. His father was atheist. However he has no objec- tion to his Catholic wife raising Cath. Children. Jan. 20th, 18 Back reported cured
11 Joseph Buchnet 24 - poisoned dying already unconscious is Enrolled at 8 P.M. perpetual ...
Rose Muenz - 60 - arthritis 8 yrs discouraged - rather giving up prayer
13 Wm. Ladouceur. a barber - bad stomach laments inability to work at kraft. suffers agony on Friday on account
Mary Marg. Sullivan - 17 - fits of somekind since 2 - now worse than ever. Sometimes discouraged.
Page 6
Mrs. Marg. Miller - 52 - lump on breast fears operation may be neces- sary - asks for prayer. Enrolled To-night 8:00 promising further -- perpetual
(Jennie) - Walter Gronek - 30 - away from home and family - and prac- tice of faith - wife asks for prayers ..
Sophie Haener - 56 - Very serious kidney trouble with terrible back- ache
Frank & Ella Daly (Mt. Clement) Elderly people not going to sacraments though charitable people ...
Anthony Shafran - married 12 year refuses to speak to parents.
Joseph Rademacher - 61 - cancer - given up by Drs as hopeless ... last Thanksgiving-now working O.K.
Frances Bedgenska .. 41 .. nervous BK.
Mrs. Cath. Ames
